headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Core enterprise cloud computing, database, and generative AI infrastructure platform revenue.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: High-margin digital retail media ad revenues from sponsored products, video streaming, and display ads.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP operating profit across North America, International, and AWS.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Worldwide Operating Income: Reached $27,461M in Q2 2026 (13.7% operating margin); Street models $18,500M in Q3 2026E (guidance corridor $16.5B to $20.5B; whisper >$19.5B).

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Commissions, fulfillment (FBA), and shipping fees generated from marketplace third-party merchants.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: 3P Seller Services: Generated $46,780M in Q2 2026; Street models $44,500M in Q3 2026E (whisper $45,200M) as 3P unit mix accounts for >61% of total paid units on Amazon's global marketplace.
